title: RAVL: Discovering and Mitigating Spurious Correlations in Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures this bias by computing a 'cluster performance gap', which evaluates the difference in zero-shot classification accuracy on images with and without specific localized image features (e.g., medical devices, text markers, synthetic shapes, backgrounds). It uses an automated region-level clustering approach to identify fine-grained image regions that models learn to spuriously correlate with specific textual attributes.
